cases.purpose: Compare usage, missing and mixed operands, ext4 ioctl errors, FIFO, live and dangling symlinks, unknown flags, and explicitly mounted tmpfs flag behavior; verify flag state after each operation.
cases.oracle: e2fsprogs 1.47.2 chattr, flags read with e2fsprogs lsattr
cases.comparison: Byte parity with e2fsprogs 1.47.2, including statuses, diagnostics and lsattr state; ext4 and tmpfs mounts must succeed or the fixture exits 99.
cases.script:
strip() { /usr/bin/sed -E 's/^[^:]*: line [0-9]+: //' "$1" | /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|'; }
show() { printf '%s status=%s out=' "$1" "$2"; /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|' < /tmp/rf.out; printf ' err='; strip /tmp/rf.err; echo; }
r() { local l=$1; shift; "$@" >/tmp/rf.out 2>/tmp/rf.err; show "$l" $?; }
u() { local g=--clear-groups; [[ $3 ]] && g=--groups=$3
  /usr/bin/setpriv --reuid=2000 --regid=2000 $g -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "$2" >/tmp/rf.out 2>/tmp/rf.err; show "$1" $?; }
I=/tmp/root-fixture.img M=/tmp/root-fixture-mnt
/usr/bin/truncate -s 4M $I && /usr/sbin/mkfs.ext4 -q -F -O ^has_journal $I && /usr/bin/mkdir $M && /usr/bin/mount -o loop $I $M || { echo SETUP-FAILED; exit 99; }
cd $M
lsa() { for f in "$@"; do /usr/bin/lsattr -d "$f" 2>&1 | /usr/bin/sed -E 's/^[^:]*: line [0-9]+: //'; done | /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|'; echo; }
printf 'a\n' > f1; printf 'b\n' > f2; /usr/bin/mkfifo p; /usr/bin/ln -s f1 l; /usr/bin/ln -s missing dangling
r no-args chattr
r no-spec chattr f1
r spec-only chattr +d
r mixed-missing chattr +d f1 missing f2; echo "  $(lsa f1 f2)"
r clear-extents chattr -e f1;  echo "  $(lsa f1)"
r fifo chattr +A p f2;         echo "  $(lsa f2)"
r symlink chattr +s l;         echo "  $(lsa f1)"
r dangling chattr +d dangling; echo "  $(lsa f1)"
r unknown-letter chattr +Q f2; echo "  $(lsa f2)"
r unknown-then-valid chattr +AQ f1; echo "  $(lsa f1)"
r mixed-link chattr +A f1 l f2; echo "  $(lsa f1 f2)"
/usr/bin/mkdir /tmp/chattr-tmpfs && /usr/bin/mount -t tmpfs tmpfs /tmp/chattr-tmpfs || { echo TMPFS-SETUP-FAILED; exit 99; }
cd /tmp/chattr-tmpfs; printf 'c\n' > t
r tmpfs-sync chattr +S t; echo "  $(/usr/bin/lsattr t 2>&1 | /usr/bin/sed -E 's/^[^:]*: line [0-9]+: //')"
r tmpfs-nodump chattr +d t; echo "  $(/usr/bin/lsattr t 2>&1 | /usr/bin/sed -E 's/^[^:]*: line [0-9]+: //')"
cd /tmp/parity-case && /usr/bin/umount /tmp/chattr-tmpfs || { echo TMPFS-TEARDOWN-FAILED; exit 99; }
cd /tmp/parity-case && /usr/bin/umount $M && /usr/bin/rm -f $I && echo teardown=ok
